set.body:
Follow-up found while landing bd-01M2TA3KKCFS707G2XJ9TS7ZCJ (commit 3a7fc0cf). That ticket's named files are corrected; these public docs-site pages carry the same false or overstated claims and were left alone because they carry evidence badges and verification.

Scope: text only, no behaviour change.

1. docs-site/src/content/docs/scala/modules.mdx:11 says "15 cross-platform modules and three JVM-only". build.sbt has 16 cross-platform (allModules, :490) and 8 JVM-only (jvmOnlyModules, :510); the module table needs the missing rows.
2. docs-site/.../scala/inspect-source.mdx:50,56 and summarize-recall.mdx:48 list a local grakern checkout as a prerequisite or use -D in commands. sbt clones the public pin without an override (build.sbt:251-263); -D is optional.
3. orientation.mdx:32-33,50-52 and summarize-recall.mdx:33-35 list fidelity, distortion and intrusion outputs without the no-efficacy-evidence caveat that README now carries.

Acceptance: each page matches build.sbt and README's corrected statements; any evidence badge/PRODUCER_REVISION the page carries is updated honestly or the verifier's rule for it is followed; cd docs-site && npm run verify:examples (and the page verifiers the site uses) pass; commit body lists grep commands showing the stale phrases are gone. Historical ledger docs-site/EVIDENCE.md:47 (dated 2026-08-30) is not edited.
set.title: [foundation] correct stale claims on docs-site pages (module count, grakern prerequisite, efficacy caveat)
